stages.discovery: A ring of pale, faintly glowing mushroom-folk stand motionless among the toadstools, swaying gently though there's no wind. They seem to be watching you without eyes.
stages.investigate_message: You step past the ring of mushroom caps for a closer look.

choices.label: Offer a Gift
choices.description: Leave a bit of food among the ring
choices.outcome: You set a heel of bread at the ring's edge. The myconids sway toward it, and a soft cloud of luminous spores drifts your way, leaving you strangely at ease.

choices.label: Stand Quietly Among Them
choices.description: Just watch, and let them watch back
choices.outcome: You stand still until the swaying settles into a slow, unified rhythm you find yourself falling into without meaning to. After a while, you walk on undisturbed.

choices.label: Step Into the Ring
choices.description: Walk in among them for a closer look

choices.label: Move On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - leave the grove undisturbed

stages.ignore: You give the ring a wide berth and continue on your way.
